FaceAt.text: FaceAt is the face p lies on, within a hundredth of a millimetre.

Problems.text:
Problems lists what is wrong with the solid's topology: edges not
shared by two faces, loops that don't close; none for a sound solid.

SolidEdge.text: SolidEdge is an edge of a solid, by name.

Describe.text: Describe names the edge for a person.

Ends.text: Ends are the edge's two vertices' positions.

Faces.text: Faces are the two faces the edge lies between.

Length.text: Length is the edge's length in mm.

Name.text:
Name is the edge's name, "edge A B N": the two faces' identities in
hex and its place among the edges between them. Solid.Edge reads it
back.

Points.text: Points are points along the edge, from one end to the other.

Straight.text: Straight reports whether the edge is a line segment.

SolidFace.text:
SolidFace is a face of a solid: its identity, the sketch entity that
made it or the group whose surface it is, and which of the faces
with that identity it is.

Edges.text: Edges are the edges round the face.

Entity.text:
Entity is the face entity that made the face, which constraints can
use; it fails for a face that no entity names.

ID.text:
ID is the face's identity: the handle of the entity that made it,
or for a face no entity names, a number made of the group that made
it and its place among that group's surfaces.

Name.text: Name names the face: the entity that made it, or the group.

Neighbours.text: Neighbours are the faces that share an edge with this one.

SolidVertex.text: SolidVertex is a vertex of a solid, by position.

Edges.text: Edges are the edges that end at the vertex.

SuppressMode.text: SuppressMode is how much of a group is left out of the model.

ThreadOptions.text:
ThreadOptions are what New Group > Screw Thread asks for. The zero
value is what the screen starts with: the standard thread nearest
the circle's diameter, external, one and a half diameters long,
ending at a shoulder.

Vec.text: Vec is a point or a direction in space, in mm.

Current.text:
Current is the document the script was run on: the drawing on screen
in the application, the file named on the command line of the
command-line tool, or a new sketch. A script compiled as a program
of its own gets a new sketch too, unless it called SetCurrent.

Import.text:
Import converts the SolveSpace model src (.slvs) to the spacesolve
model dst (.spcs), and opens it. Every SolveSpace model src links is
converted too, to a .spcs file beside it, and the links are pointed
at those; a converted file that exists already is used as it is. The
.slvs files are not changed. It fails when a linked file is missing,
when the links form a cycle, or when a file can't be written.

Inch.text: Inch is v inches in mm.

New.text:
New is a new, empty sketch, as File > New makes: the three reference
workplanes and a group to draw in, in the XY plane.

NewDoc.text:
NewDoc is the document of a host. The application makes the one a
script gets from Current; a program of its own makes them with New
and Open.

NewSketchHost.text:
NewSketchHost hosts sk, which was loaded from or will be saved to
saveFile ("" for none).

Open.text:
Open loads a sketch from a .spcs file. A SolveSpace model (.slvs) is
converted with Import instead.

SetCommandList.text:
SetCommandList is how the user interface tells this package its
commands; scripts don't call it.

SetCurrent.text: SetCurrent sets what Current returns in a compiled program.

ThreadNearest.text:
ThreadNearest is the designation of the standard thread whose major
diameter is nearest d mm, as the screw thread screen first offers.

V.decl: func V(x, y, z float64) Vec
V.text: V is the vector (x, y, z).

Assemble.text: How a group's solid combines with the solid so far.

Difference.text: How a group's solid combines with the solid so far.

Intersection.text: How a group's solid combines with the solid so far.

SuppressSolid.text:
The suppress modes: nothing left out, the solid only, or the whole
group with every group that uses it.

SuppressWhole.text:
The suppress modes: nothing left out, the solid only, or the whole
group with every group that uses it.

Union.text: How a group's solid combines with the solid so far.

Unsuppressed.text:
The suppress modes: nothing left out, the solid only, or the whole
group with every group that uses it.

BrokenReference.text: BrokenReference is a request, constraint or group that a regeneration deleted, because something it referred to was gone.

String.text: String says what was deleted and why: "deleted c012-pt-pt-distance of g004-sketch-in-plane, which used r005-line-segment of g002-sketch-in-plane".

Clipboard.text: Clipboard holds copied requests, and the constraints among them (C++ SolveSpaceUI::Clipboard).

ContainsEntity.text: ContainsEntity reports whether he, or no entity, was copied (C++ Clipboard::ContainsEntity).

NewEntityFor.text: NewEntityFor is the pasted entity for copied entity he (C++ Clipboard::NewEntityFor).

ClipboardRequest.text: ClipboardRequest is a copied request: its points in the workplane's coordinates, and the entities it came from (C++ ClipboardRequest).

CopyAs.text: CopyAs is the transformation a copied entity gets (C++ Group::CopyAs).

Dependency.text: Dependency is one group that another group needs, and the first reason found for it.

EntityBezierResolver.text: EntityBezierResolver is the lookup interface that GenerateEntityBeziers needs to evaluate entity points, normals, and radii at solve time.

ExportSettings.text: ExportSettings are the user's export settings (C++ SS.exportChordTol, exportMaxSegments and exportScale).

ChordTolMm.text: ChordTolMm is the export chord tolerance in mm (C++ SS.ExportChordTolMm).

ExprError.text: ExprError is a stored expression of a constraint or a group that could not be evaluated.

Freedom.text: Freedom is how much of an entity its group's constraints fix.

GenerateType.text: GenerateType is which groups GenerateAll solves (C++ SolveSpaceUI::Generate): all of them; from the first dirty or unsolved one to the active one; none, only regenerating the entities; or up to the active one.

AssembleLoops.decl: func (g *Group) AssembleLoops(sk *Sketch, rt EntityBezierResolver) (allClosed, allCoplanar, allNonZeroLen bool)
AssembleLoops.text: AssembleLoops converts this group's visible, non-construction entities into Bezier curves and assembles them into closed loops: the outer loops grouped with their holes go into g.BezierLoops (and their pwl into g.PolyLoops), the leftovers into g.BezierOpens.

Clear.text: Clear drops everything regeneration makes, and the remap table (C++ Group::Clear).

CopyEntity.decl: func (g *Group) CopyEntity(sk *Sketch, el *[]core.Entity, ep *core.Entity, timesApplied, remap int, dx, dy, dz, qw, qvx, qvy, qvz, dist core.HParam, as CopyAs)
CopyEntity.text: CopyEntity appends a transformed copy of ep (C++ Group::CopyEntity).

DescriptionString.text: DescriptionString names the group as the property browser does: "g003-extrude".

ExtrusionForceVectorTo.text: ExtrusionForceVectorTo sets the extrusion vector's parameters (C++ Group::ExtrusionForceVectorTo).

ExtrusionGetVector.text: ExtrusionGetVector returns the extrusion vector, from its parameters (C++ Group::ExtrusionGetVector).

FieldName.text: FieldName is the value's name in the file and in messages for this group: a chamfer's distance is ValB, as a helix's pitch is.

Generate.text: Generate creates this group's entities and params (C++ Group::Generate).

GenerateDisplayItems.text: GenerateDisplayItems builds the mesh and outlines to display: the previous group's, if this group adds no solid, else the running shell triangulated, with the running mesh (C++ Group::GenerateDisplayItems).

GenerateEquations.text: GenerateEquations appends the group's own equations (C++ Group::GenerateEquations).

GenerateLoops.text: GenerateLoops rebuilds this group's loops: for sketch-like groups it assembles them from the group's entities and records the polygon error, otherwise it just clears them.

GenerateShellAndMesh.text: GenerateShellAndMesh builds this group's shell (by extrusion, revolution, step and repeat, or linking), and combines it with the previous group's running shell by the group's Boolean (C++ Group::GenerateShellAndMesh).

IsCopyGroup.text: IsCopyGroup reports whether the group copies its source group, entities and solid, and combines the copies with what came before the source: step and repeat, and mirror.

IsForcedToMesh.text: IsForcedToMesh reports whether the group is built as a triangle mesh instead of a shell: asked to be, an imported mesh, or combined with a mesh (C++ Group::IsForcedToMesh).

IsForcedToMeshBySource.text: IsForcedToMeshBySource reports whether the group combines with a group forced to a mesh (C++ Group::IsForcedToMeshBySource).

IsMeshGroup2.text: IsMeshGroup returns true if this group produces a mesh output (EXTRUDE, LATHE, REVOLVE, HELIX, ROTATE, TRANSLATE).

IsTriangleMeshAssembly.text: IsTriangleMeshAssembly reports whether the group links a triangle mesh, without a shell (C++ Group::IsTriangleMeshAssembly).

LoftTurn.text: LoftTurn is how many curves on the loft joins the second profile's curves turned by, in 0 to the count less one.

MakeLatheCircles.decl: func (g *Group) MakeLatheCircles(sk *Sketch, el *[]core.Entity, in core.HEntity, pt, axis geom.Vector)

MakeLatheSurfacesSelectable.decl: func (g *Group) MakeLatheSurfacesSelectable(sk *Sketch, el *[]core.Entity, in core.HEntity, axis geom.Vector)

MakeRevolveEndFaces.decl: func (g *Group) MakeRevolveEndFaces(sk *Sketch, el *[]core.Entity, pt core.HEntity, ai, af int)
MakeRevolveEndFaces.text: For Revolve and Helix groups the end faces are remapped from an arbitrary point on the sketch.

RemapEntity.decl: func (g *Group) RemapEntity(in core.HEntity, copyNumber int) core.HEntity
RemapEntity.text: RemapEntity returns the handle of copy copyNumber of entity in, allocating a new one in the group's remap table if needed (C++ Group::Remap).

SetRemapEntry.decl: func (g *Group) SetRemapEntry(input core.HEntity, copyNumber int, id core.EntityID)
SetRemapEntry.text: SetRemapEntry installs an entry in this group's remap table.

Topology.text: Topology is the topology of the solid so far at this group, its running shell, derived on first use after a regeneration: the faces, edges and vertices that edge names refer to.

TransformImportedBy.decl: func (g *Group) TransformImportedBy(sk *Sketch, t geom.Vector, q geom.Quaternion)
TransformImportedBy.text: TransformImportedBy moves a linked group by t and rotates it by q, composing them into its placement parameters (C++ Group::TransformImportedBy).

Value.text: Value returns the field's number and its expression, both addressable.

GroupProblem.text: GroupProblem is a diagnostic on a group: a message and, when the problem has a place, the point it is at.

GroupValue.text: GroupValue names a group value that may hold an expression.

Field.text: Field is the value's name in the file.

Image.text: Image is a loaded image file (C++ Pixmap): its size in pixels, which sets an image request's aspect ratio, and its pixels, for drawing.

MeasureKind.text: MeasureKind is what a measurement is.

MoveError.text: MoveError is why a group can't move where it was asked to: Group would come before On, which it refers to through Why.

Parameter.text: Parameter is a named value that expressions can use.

Generate.text: Generate adds the entities and params of the request (C++ Request::Generate).

Runtime.text: Runtime provides quick handle-based lookup for a Sketch.

Constraint.text: Constraint retrieves a constraint by handle.

DistanceValue.text: DistanceValue returns numeric distance for distance entity types.

Entity.text: Entity retrieves an entity by handle.

Group.text: Group retrieves a group by handle.

Normal.text: Normal is an alias for NormalQuaternion that satisfies the EntityBezierResolver interface.

NormalQuaternion.text: NormalQuaternion returns the unit quaternion orientation for the entity referenced by h.

Param.text: Param retrieves a parameter by handle, reading the sketch live.

ParamValue.text: ParamValue implements core.NumericalResolver, returning the numeric value for the supplied parameter handle.

Point.text: Point is an alias for PointValue that satisfies the EntityBezierResolver interface.

PointValue.text: PointValue returns the numeric location for the entity referenced by h.

Radius.text: Radius returns the radius of a circle/arc entity.

Rebuild.text: Rebuild refreshes all handle indexes after the sketch mutates.

RecalculateEntities.text: RecalculateEntities caches every entity's numeric state in its Act* fields (Entity::CalculateNumerical).

Request.text: Request retrieves a request by handle.

Style.text: Style retrieves a style by handle.

StyleForEntity.text: StyleForEntity is the style entity h draws in; part of the EntityBezierResolver interface.

Section.text: Section is the section view (an extension): the solid is drawn cut by a plane, the part on the side the plane's normal points to taken away and the cut capped.

Selection.text: Selection is a selected entity or constraint (C++ Selection).

ActiveGroup.text: ActiveGroup is the active group: Active if it exists, else the one C++ makes active after loading a file (GraphicsWindow::Init and EnsureValidActives): the last group, or the first that isn't the references.

ActiveWorkplane.text: ActiveWorkplane is the active group's workplane (C++ GraphicsWindow::ActiveWorkplane).

AddConstraintRemember.text: AddConstraintRemember adds c with a new handle, and its params, and marks its group dirty (C++ Constraint::AddConstraint).

AddGroupAfterActive.text: AddGroupAfterActive adds g right after the active group, moving the later groups down, and gives a group that makes a solid the colour of the solid so far (C++ Group::MenuGroup).

AddParameter.text: AddParameter adds a parameter at the end of the table.

AddReferences.text: AddReferences adds the references group and its three coordinate plane workplanes, which every sketch has; the first half of C++ SolveSpaceUI::NewFile.

AddRequestOfType.decl: func (sk *Sketch) AddRequestOfType(typ RequestType, rememberForUndo bool) core.HRequest
AddRequestOfType.text: AddRequestOfType adds a request of the given type in the active group and workplane, and generates its entities and params, without solving (C++ GraphicsWindow::AddRequest).

AddThread.decl: func (sk *Sketch) AddThread(he core.HEntity, o ThreadOptions) (ThreadResult, error)
AddThread.text: AddThread makes a screw thread on the circle or arc he, along its normal, after the active group: a sketch and a lathe group that turn the part down to the root of the thread (or bore it out, for an internal thread), then a sketch of the ridge and a helix group that sweeps it.

BumpOrderAfterActive.text: BumpOrderAfterActive gives g the order after the active group's and moves the groups after that one down.

CalculateEntityBBox.text: CalculateEntityBBox returns the bounding box of the non-construction entities (C++ Sketch::CalculateEntityBBox).

CheckMoveGroup.text: CheckMoveGroup reports the error MoveGroup(h, before) would give, without moving anything.

CheckThread.decl: func (sk *Sketch) CheckThread(he core.HEntity, o ThreadOptions) error
CheckThread.text: CheckThread reports why AddThread would refuse to make the thread, without changing anything.

ChordTolPercent.text: ChordTolPercent is the chord tolerance in effect, as a percentage of the model's size.

ClearBrokenReferences.text: ClearBrokenReferences empties the list of what regenerations deleted.

ClearExisting.text: ClearExisting drops the whole sketch and the undo history, leaving it without even the references; the caller must fix that (C++ SolveSpaceUI::ClearExisting).

ClearSection.text: ClearSection turns the section view off.

Constrain.decl: func (sk *Sketch) Constrain(typ core.ConstraintType, ptA, ptB, entityA, entityB core.HEntity, other, other2 bool) core.HConstraint
Constrain.text: Constrain adds a constraint of the given type in the active group and workplane (C++ Constraint::Constrain).

ConstrainArcLineTangent.decl: func (sk *Sketch) ConstrainArcLineTangent(c *core.Constraint, line, arc, arcEndpoint *core.Entity) error
ConstrainArcLineTangent.text: ConstrainArcLineTangent sets which end of arc c makes tangent to line: the one they share, else arcEndpoint (C++ Constraint::ConstrainArcLineTangent, which reports the error to the user).

ConstrainCoincident.text: ConstrainCoincident makes points ptA and ptB coincident (C++ Constraint::ConstrainCoincident).

ConstrainCubicLineTangent.decl: func (sk *Sketch) ConstrainCubicLineTangent(c *core.Constraint, line, cubic, curveEndpoint *core.Entity) error
ConstrainCubicLineTangent.text: ConstrainCubicLineTangent sets which end of cubic c makes tangent to line (C++ Constraint::ConstrainCubicLineTangent).

ConstrainCurveCurveTangent.decl: func (sk *Sketch) ConstrainCurveCurveTangent(c *core.Constraint, eA, eB, epA, epB *core.Entity) error
ConstrainCurveCurveTangent.text: ConstrainCurveCurveTangent sets at which ends c makes curves eA and eB tangent: the ends they share, else epA and epB (C++ Constraint::ConstrainCurveCurveTangent).

CopySelection.text: CopySelection copies the selected entities that requests generate (not workplanes), the selected comments, and the constraints among the copied entities (C++ GraphicsWindow::CopySelection).

CreateAllDefaultStyles.text: CreateAllDefaultStyles makes sure the sketch has every default style (C++ Style::CreateAllDefaultStyles).

CreateDefaultDrawingGroup.text: CreateDefaultDrawingGroup adds the empty group in the XY plane that a new file starts in (C++ SolveSpaceUI::CreateDefaultDrawingGroup).

CreateDefaultStyle.text: CreateDefaultStyle adds style h: the default style it names, or else a custom one like the active group's (C++ Style::CreateDefaultStyle).

CreateParam.decl: func (sk *Sketch) CreateParam(h core.HParam, val float64) core.HParam
CreateParam.text: CreateParam adds a new parameter to the sketch.

DeleteAllConstraintsFor.decl: func (sk *Sketch) DeleteAllConstraintsFor(typ core.ConstraintType, entityA, ptA core.HEntity)
DeleteAllConstraintsFor.text: DeleteAllConstraintsFor deletes the constraints of the given type on entityA and ptA; used when auto-removing constraints that would become redundant (C++ Constraint::DeleteAllConstraintsFor).

DeleteSelection.text: DeleteSelection deletes the selected requests (not the references) and constraints (C++ GraphicsWindow::DeleteSelection).

DeleteTaggedRequests.text: DeleteTaggedRequests deletes the tagged requests, fixing up the point-coincident constraints on their points, and regenerates (C++ GraphicsWindow::DeleteTaggedRequests).

DistanceLabelOffset.text: DistanceLabelOffset is where the label of a new distance between points at a and b goes, as Constrain > Distance puts it: 50 pixels from the middle, across the line between them in the view (C++ GraphicsWindow::MenuConstrain).

EntitiesToMap.text: EntitiesToMap returns the entities indexed by their handle.

EntityFreedom.text: EntityFreedom is how much of entity he its group's constraints fix: whether all, some or none of the params it is made of, and that its group solves for, can move.

EntityIsVisible.text: EntityIsVisible is C++ Entity::IsVisible, with the show flags of sk.Show (GraphicsWindow::Init's when nil).

EntityName.text: entityName names entity he, which may have been deleted since the last regeneration, by its request or its group.

EvaluateParameters.text: EvaluateParameters evaluates the parameter table, then every stored expression, and writes the numbers into the values they drive.

ExportMeshTo.decl: func (sk *Sketch) ExportMeshTo(filename string, es ExportSettings) error
ExportMeshTo.text: ExportMeshTo writes the active group's mesh, regenerated at the export chord tolerance, to filename; the extension picks the format, and only STL is supported.

FaceName.text: FaceName names a face of a solid by its identity: the entity that made it, or for a face no entity names, the group that made it.

FixConstraintsForPointBeingDeleted.text: FixConstraintsForPointBeingDeleted deletes the point-coincident constraints on hpt, and makes the points they joined to it coincident with each other (C++ GraphicsWindow::FixConstraintsForPointBeingDeleted).

FixConstraintsForRequestBeingDeleted.text: FixConstraintsForRequestBeingDeleted keeps the points made coincident through a point of request hr, which is being deleted, coincident (C++ GraphicsWindow::FixConstraintsForRequestBeingDeleted).

ForceReferences.text: ForceReferences forces the values of the params that define the three reference coordinate systems (C++ SolveSpaceUI::ForceReferences).

FreezeDefaultStyles.text: FreezeDefaultStyles saves the default styles as the user's settings, with widths and text heights at the view's scale (C++ Style::FreezeDefaultStyles).

GenerateAll.text: GenerateAll regenerates the whole model: every group's entities and params, then the solve, loops and shells.

GenerateAllFindFree.text: GenerateAllFindFree regenerates like GenerateAllTyped and also works out which parameters are free, for Analyze > Show Degrees of Freedom (C++ GenerateAll with andFindFree).

GenerateAllTyped.text: GenerateAllTyped is GenerateAll with a GenerateType.

GroupDependencies.text: GroupDependencies lists the groups group h refers to, each once, in history order: through its operand, its workplane and predefined entities, the entities its requests and constraints name, and the sources of its copied entities.

GroupDependents.text: GroupDependents lists the groups that refer to group h directly, in history order.

GroupFreedom.text: GroupFreedom reports which of the params group hg solves for are free to move, at the values of the last regeneration; nil when the group did not solve or is too large.

GroupName.text: anyGroupName names group h, which may have been deleted since the last regeneration.

GroupsInOrder.text: groupsInOrder reports whether before comes before after (C++ GroupsInOrder).

LoadFactoryDefaults.text: LoadFactoryDefaults resets the default styles to their factory settings (C++ Style::LoadFactoryDefaults; the background colour it also resets is the user interface's).

LockedInWorkplane.text: LockedInWorkplane is whether the active group sketches in a workplane (C++ GraphicsWindow::LockedInWorkplane).

MakeTangentArc.decl: func (sk *Sketch) MakeTangentArc(hpt core.HEntity, settings TangentArcSettings) error
MakeTangentArc.text: MakeTangentArc rounds the corner at point hpt, where two non-construction line segments or arcs join, with a tangent arc (C++ GraphicsWindow::MakeTangentArc).

MarkGroupDirty.text: MarkGroupDirty marks group hg, and unless onlyThis every group after it, as needing regeneration, and schedules it (C++ SolveSpaceUI::MarkGroupDirty).

MarkGroupDirtyByEntity.text: MarkGroupDirtyByEntity marks the group of entity he dirty (C++ SolveSpaceUI::MarkGroupDirtyByEntity).

Measure.text: Measure measures entities, as the description of the selection does: one line segment or circle; two points; a point and a circle, line segment or plane face; two lines, normals or plane faces; or two points and a line along which to project their distance.

MirrorPlaneOK.text: MirrorPlaneOK reports whether he can be the plane of a mirror: a workplane or a planar face.

MoveGroup.text: MoveGroup moves group h to just before group before in the history, or to the end for the zero handle.

MustGetEntity.text: MustGetEntity is GetEntity for handles that must exist (C++ SK.GetEntity, which asserts).

MustGetParam.text: MustGetParam is GetParam for handles that must exist (C++ SK.GetParam, which asserts).

NewChamfer.decl: func (sk *Sketch) NewChamfer(edges []core.HEntity, solidEdges []topo.Name, distance float64, name string) (Group, error)
NewChamfer.text: NewChamfer starts a chamfer at the active group, of edges of the solid so far: line segments along edges between two planar faces, and edges of the solid itself, by name, straight and between two planar faces; at distance mm from each edge on both faces.

NewFile.text: NewFile makes the sketch a new, empty file: the references group with the three reference workplanes, and a drawing group (C++ SolveSpaceUI::NewFile).

NewFillet.decl: func (sk *Sketch) NewFillet(edges []core.HEntity, solidEdges []topo.Name, radius float64, name string) (Group, error)
NewFillet.text: NewFillet starts a fillet at the active group, of edges of the solid so far, given as line segment entities or by name, with radius mm.

NewLoft.decl: func (sk *Sketch) NewLoft(from, to core.HGroup, name string) (Group, error)
NewLoft.text: NewLoft starts a loft from the profile of group from to that of group to, both sketches in workplanes with one closed loop of the same number of curves.

NewMirror.decl: func (sk *Sketch) NewMirror(plane core.HEntity, name string) (Group, error)
NewMirror.text: NewMirror starts a mirror group that reflects the active group in plane, a workplane or a planar face.

NewShell.decl: func (sk *Sketch) NewShell(faces []srf.FaceID, thick float64, name string) (Group, error)
NewShell.text: NewShell starts a shell at the active group, hollowing the solid so far to walls thick mm, open at faces.

NewSweep.text: NewSweep starts a sweep of the active group's sketch along path, line segments and arcs joined end to end and meeting tangent.

Parameter.text: Parameter returns the parameter named name, or nil.

ParameterUsers.text: ParameterUsers describes what names the parameter: other parameters, constraints and group values.

ParamsToMap.text: ParamsToMap returns the current param values as a map from handle to float64.

PasteClipboard.decl: func (sk *Sketch) PasteClipboard(trans geom.Vector, theta, scale float64) []Selection
PasteClipboard.text: PasteClipboard pastes the clipboard into the active group and workplane: scaled (mirrored if negative) in the workplane, rotated by theta about its normal, and moved by trans.

PopOntoCurrentFrom.text: PopOntoCurrentFrom makes the last state on uk the current one, then reloads the linked files and regenerates (C++ SolveSpaceUI::PopOntoCurrentFrom).

ProjectPoint.text: ProjectPoint projects p to the screen in the sketch's view (C++ GraphicsWindow::ProjectPoint).

PruneGroups.text: PruneGroups removes group hg if its operand or predef entities don't exist (yet), and reports whether it did (C++ SolveSpaceUI::PruneGroups).

PruneOrphans.text: PruneOrphans removes requests and constraints whose group doesn't exist (C++ SolveSpaceUI::PruneOrphans).

PruneRequestsAndConstraints.text: PruneRequestsAndConstraints removes group hg's requests and constraints that refer to entities that don't exist (C++ SolveSpaceUI::PruneRequestsAndConstraints).

PushFromCurrentOnto.text: PushFromCurrentOnto records the current state on uk, over its oldest one when it's full (C++ SolveSpaceUI::PushFromCurrentOnto).

Refresh.text: Refresh does the scheduled regeneration (C++ SolveSpaceUI::Refresh; showing the text window is the caller's).

RegenerationPending.text: RegenerationPending reports whether a regeneration is scheduled and hasn't run, so that what is read from the sketch may be stale.

RemoveConstraintsForPointBeingDeleted.text: RemoveConstraintsForPointBeingDeleted deletes the constraints on hpt (C++ GraphicsWindow::RemoveConstraintsForPointBeingDeleted).

RenameParameter.text: RenameParameter renames a parameter and every use of it, in other parameters, in constraints and in groups.

ReplacePointInConstraints.text: ReplacePointInConstraints moves the constraints on oldpt to newpt (C++ GraphicsWindow::ReplacePointInConstraints).

ScheduleGenerateAll.text: ScheduleGenerateAll asks for a regeneration of the dirty groups when Refresh next runs (C++ SolveSpaceUI::ScheduleGenerateAll, which Refresh serves after the pending events).

SectionCut.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SectionCut() (keep srf.HalfSpace, origin geom.Vector, ok bool, err error)
SectionCut.text: SectionCut is where the section view cuts now: the half space it keeps, and a point on its plane.

SectionPlaneName.text: SectionPlaneName names the section's plane for the user: a workplane by its request or group, a face by its group.

SetConstraintText.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetConstraintText(hc core.HConstraint, text string) error
SetConstraintText.text: SetConstraintText gives a constraint the value of what the user typed for its label, a length in the document's unit (Units).

SetEntityActPoint.text: SetEntityActPoint updates an entity's cached actPoint.

SetGroupText.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetGroupText(hg core.HGroup, f GroupValue, text string) error
SetGroupText.text: SetGroupText gives a group value what the user typed, as SetConstraintText does for a constraint: a pitch is in the document's unit.

SetParameterExpr.text: SetParameterExpr gives a parameter a new expression.

SetSection.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetSection(plane core.HEntity, offset string, flip bool) error
SetSection.text: SetSection turns the section view on, cutting parallel to plane, a workplane or a planar face, offset (typed, in the document's unit; "" is zero) along its normal, away from the side flip picks.

SetSuppressAll.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SetSuppressAll(h core.HGroup, on bool) error
SetSuppressAll.text: SetSuppressAll suppresses group h whole, or brings it back, and has the model regenerated.

SetUnits.text: SetUnits makes u the document's unit, keeping every size: a plain value is a number of millimetres and does not change, and a stored expression of a length is rewritten to give the same length in u, "(1/4)*25.4" from "1/4" in inches to millimetres, or back again without the factor.

ShowNakedEdges.text: ShowNakedEdges finds the active group's naked and self-intersecting edges, and reports them through Message; with reportOnlyWhenNotOkay, only if there are any.

SolidAt.text: SolidAt is the group whose running solid is the model at group hg, or nil when there is none: the solid whose edges a chamfer there cuts and the interface lets the user pick.

SolidEdgeName.text: SolidEdgeName names an edge of a solid for a person: the faces it lies between.

SolveGroupAndReport.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SolveGroupAndReport(hg core.HGroup, groupParams []core.HParam, andFindFree bool)
SolveGroupAndReport.text: SolveGroupAndReport solves group hg for groupParams, the params its requests, constraints and the group itself generate, holding every other param fixed (C++ SolveSpaceUI::SolveGroup, with WriteEqSystemForGroup).

SplitCircle.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SplitCircle(he core.HEntity, pinter geom.Vector) core.HEntity
SplitCircle.text: SplitCircle splits circle or arc he at pinter: a circle into a 360 degree arc, an arc into two.

SplitCubic.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SplitCubic(he core.HEntity, pinter geom.Vector) core.HEntity
SplitCubic.text: SplitCubic splits cubic he at pinter into cubic segments, and returns the point at the split (C++ GraphicsWindow::SplitCubic).

SplitEntity.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SplitEntity(he core.HEntity, pinter geom.Vector) (core.HEntity, error)
SplitEntity.text: SplitEntity splits line, circle or cubic he at pinter, deletes the request it came from (unless that's construction or in another group), and returns the point at the split (C++ GraphicsWindow::SplitEntity).

SplitLine.decl: func (sk *Sketch) SplitLine(he core.HEntity, pinter geom.Vector) core.HEntity
SplitLine.text: SplitLine splits line segment he at pinter into two, and returns the point where they join (C++ GraphicsWindow::SplitLine).

SplitLinesOrCurves.text: SplitLinesOrCurves splits the selected entities where they intersect: two lines, circles, arcs or cubics, or one of them and a point on it.

StyleColor.decl: func (sk *Sketch) StyleColor(h core.HStyle, forExport, fixExportColors bool) core.RgbaColor
StyleColor.text: StyleColor is style h's stroke colour, rewritten for export as RewriteColor says (C++ Style::Color).

StyleExportable.text: StyleExportable reports whether lines of style h go in exported files: if it's both shown and exportable (C++ Style::Exportable).

StyleFillColor.decl: func (sk *Sketch) StyleFillColor(h core.HStyle, forExport, fixExportColors bool) core.RgbaColor
StyleFillColor.text: StyleFillColor is style h's fill colour (C++ Style::FillColor).

StyleForEntity.text: StyleForEntity is the style entity he draws in: its own, else by whether it's in the active group, or construction (C++ Style::ForEntity).

StyleGet.text: StyleGet is style h, created with default settings if the sketch doesn't have it yet; no style means the active group's (C++ Style::Get).

StylePatternType.text: StylePatternType is style h's stipple pattern (C++ Style::PatternType).

StyleStippleScale.text: StyleStippleScale is style h's stipple scale (C++ Style::StippleScale).

StyleTextHeight.decl: func (sk *Sketch) StyleTextHeight(h core.HStyle, scale float64) float64
StyleTextHeight.text: StyleTextHeight is style h's text height in pixels (C++ Style::TextHeight).

StyleWidth.decl: func (sk *Sketch) StyleWidth(h core.HStyle, scale float64) float64
StyleWidth.text: StyleWidth is style h's width in pixels, at the view's scale in pixels per mm (C++ Style::Width).

SuppressedReason.text: SuppressedReason says why group h is left out of the model, or "" if it is generated: "suppressed", or "uses g003-extrude, which is suppressed".

TestRankForGroup.text: TestRankForGroup reports whether group hg would be redundantly constrained, and its rank (C++ SolveSpaceUI::TestRankForGroup).

TryConstrain.decl: func (sk *Sketch) TryConstrain(typ core.ConstraintType, ptA, ptB, entityA, entityB core.HEntity, other, other2 bool) core.HConstraint
TryConstrain.text: TryConstrain is Constrain, except that a constraint that would be redundant isn't added; it then returns no constraint (C++ Constraint::TryConstrain).

UndoClearStack.text: UndoClearStack forgets every state on uk (C++ SolveSpaceUI::UndoClearStack).

UndoRedo.text: UndoRedo restores the last undone state (C++ SolveSpaceUI::UndoRedo).

UndoRemember.text: UndoRemember records the current state for undo, and forgets what could be redone (C++ SolveSpaceUI::UndoRemember; the unsaved flag and the menus are the caller's).

UndoRememberFor.text: UndoRememberFor records the current state for undo, as UndoRemember does, and then runs fn to change it.

UndoUndo.text: UndoUndo restores the last remembered state, keeping the current one for redo; false if there is none (C++ SolveSpaceUI::UndoUndo).

UpgradeLegacyData.text: UpgradeLegacyData brings a freshly loaded sketch up to date, and regenerates its entities without solving (C++ SolveSpaceUI::UpgradeLegacyData, which LoadFromFile ends with).

WriteEquationsExceptFor.decl: func (sk *Sketch) WriteEquationsExceptFor(hg core.HGroup, hc core.HConstraint, l *[]core.Equation)
WriteEquationsExceptFor.text: WriteEquationsExceptFor appends the equations of group hg: those of its constraints except hc, of its entities, and of the group itself (C++ System::WriteEquationsExceptFor).

SketchDiagnostic.text: SketchDiagnostic captures transient per-group errors during Sketch::GenerateAll.

TangentArcSettings.text: TangentArcSettings are the user's settings for MakeTangentArc (C++ SS.tangentArcManual, tangentArcRadius and tangentArcModify).

ThreadOptions.text: ThreadOptions is a screw thread to make on a circle.

UndoStack.text: UndoStack is a ring of up to MaxUndo states (C++ UndoStack).

UndoState.text: UndoState is one snapshot of the sketch: what can't be regenerated (C++ UndoState).

View.text: View is the map from model space to screen pixels that C++ keeps in GraphicsWindow (offset, projRight, projUp, scale) and reads through SS.GW; Tangent is SS.CameraTangent(), zero for an orthographic view.

NormalizeProjectionVectors.text: NormalizeProjectionVectors makes ProjRight and ProjUp orthonormal (C++ GraphicsWindow::NormalizeProjectionVectors).

ProjectPoint.text: ProjectPoint projects p to screen pixels (C++ GraphicsWindow::ProjectPoint).

ProjectPoint3.text: ProjectPoint3 projects p to screen pixels, z included (C++ GraphicsWindow::ProjectPoint3).

ProjectPoint4.decl: func (v *View) ProjectPoint4(p geom.Vector) (r geom.Vector, w float64)
ProjectPoint4.text: ProjectPoint4 projects p halfway into screen space: no scale and no perspective divide; w is returned (C++ GraphicsWindow::ProjectPoint4).

UnProjectPoint.text: UnProjectPoint is the point in the plane through the offset, parallel to the screen, that projects onto p (C++ GraphicsWindow::UnProjectPoint).

VectorFromProjs.text: VectorFromProjs is the model-space vector with the given right, up and forward screen components (C++ GraphicsWindow::VectorFromProjs).

Visibility.text: Visibility holds the view's show flags the engine reads (C++ GraphicsWindow::showPoints and friends): Entity::IsVisible reads the first four, Group::GenerateDisplayItems the last two.

AddParam.decl: func AddParam(param *[]core.Param, hp core.HParam, v float64)
AddParam.text: AddParam appends a group param with an initial value (C++ Group::AddParam).

AlmostEqualQuaternion.decl: func AlmostEqualQuaternion(a, b geom.Quaternion, tol float64) bool
AlmostEqualQuaternion.text: AlmostEqualQuaternion returns whether two quaternions represent the same rotation.

AlmostEqualVector.decl: func AlmostEqualVector(a, b geom.Vector, tol float64) bool
AlmostEqualVector.text: AlmostEqualVector reports whether two vectors are within tolerance.

ConstraintText.text: ConstraintText is the stored expression of a constraint as its label's editor shows it, the inverse of SetConstraintText: without the sign of a distance on the far side, and as a radius for a diameter shown as one.

ConvertLengthExpr.decl: func ConvertLengthExpr(expr string, fromMm, toMm float64) string
ConvertLengthExpr.text: ConvertLengthExpr rewrites the expression of a length in a unit of fromMm millimetres to give the same length in one of toMm: the factor between them is appended, or taken off when it is the one a conversion the other way appended.

DefaultView.text: DefaultView is the view GraphicsWindow::Init sets up: identity projection at 5 pixels per mm, orthographic.

DefaultVisibility.text: DefaultVisibility is what GraphicsWindow::Init sets: points, normals, construction and edges shown, workplanes and outlines not.

EntityPointCount.decl: func EntityPointCount(entity core.EntityType, extraPoints int) (pts int, ok bool)
EntityPointCount.text: EntityPointCount is how many points an entity of that type has (C++ EntReqTable::GetEntityInfo's pts); ok is false for a type no request makes.

ExportMeshAsStlTo.decl: func ExportMeshAsStlTo(w io.Writer, m *srf.SMesh, scale float64) error
ExportMeshAsStlTo.text: ExportMeshAsStlTo writes m as a binary STL file, in export units of scale mm (C++ SolveSpaceUI::ExportMeshAsStlTo).

GenerateConstraint.text: GenerateConstraint adds the params the constraint needs (C++ ConstraintBase::Generate).

GenerateEntityBeziers.text: GenerateEntityBeziers populates the supplied SBezierList with the piecewise-rational Bezier representation of this entity.

IsLengthValue.text: IsLengthValue reports whether a constraint's value is a length, which the interface shows in its unit, rather than an angle or a ratio.

NewGroup.text: NewGroup is a group as C++ Group::MenuGroup starts one: visible, grey, at scale 1.

NewRuntime.text: NewRuntime creates a runtime lookup wrapper for the provided sketch.

ParseExprText.text: ParseExprText parses a string expression and returns an Expr.

SetConstraintValue.text: SetConstraintValue gives a constraint the value v that the user typed: in millimetres, degrees or a ratio, the magnitude the label shows.

ThawExportSettings.text: ThawExportSettings reads the export settings, with C++'s defaults (C++ SolveSpaceUI::Init).

GroupFillet.text: Groups of this program's own, which SolveSpace has no counterpart for.

GroupShell.text: Groups of this program's own, which SolveSpace has no counterpart for.

GroupSweep.text: Groups of this program's own, which SolveSpace has no counterpart for.

HGroupReferences.text: HGroupReferences is the handle value of the references group.

MaxUndo.text: MaxUndo is the depth of the undo and redo stacks (C++ SolveSpaceUI::MAX_UNDO).

RemapLast.text: Remap keys for entity copies made by Group::Generate (C++ Group::REMAP_*).
